NGA.note: The regulator is the FCCPC, not the central bank.

facts.fact: The Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission says its Digital, Electronic, Online or Non-Traditional Consumer Lending Regulations 2025, in force since 21 July 2025, set consumer-protection rules for all digital lenders including mobile money operators.
The FCCPC invites consumers to report unlawful or unregistered digital lenders, unfair interest rates or privacy violations to its complaint portal.

NGA.note: The FCCPC channel takes complaints about lenders, not public services.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Mobile money operators are named only as lenders to be registered.
